content.value: . A 150 kW, 3000 V, 50Hz, 6 pole star connected induction motor has a star connected slip ring rotor with a transformation ration of 3:6 (Stator/ rotor). The rotor resistance is 0.1Ω per phase and it's per phase leakage reactance is 3.61mH. The star impedance may be neglected. Find the starting current and starting torque on rated voltage with sort circuited slip rings.
